svg.title: How Skylark works
svg.desc: Swimlane across three actors. You build a profile; a specialist verifies it; Skylark matches on seven weighted factors and tailors the materials; you accept or reject every change; a specialist reviews against a five-point checklist within 24 hours and submits; you track the application with its portal and confirmation reference. Statuses: saved, preparing, human review, applied, then screening, interview and offer.
